Texas B-On-Time Loan
Questions?
Ask Don!
The University of Texas at Austin has received increased funding in the Texas B-On Time Loan for 2004-2005. For information on this loan program, please visit the Texas Higher Education Co-ordination Board's web-site and read their Texas B-On-Time Loan Fact Sheet.
Eligible freshmen and sophomore students will be sent a revised Financial Aid Notification Letter by e-mail if they qualify. Students who were previously offered, but declined, the B-On Time loan and who now wish to be considered should either contact their financial aid counselor or send a request through Ask DON!.
If you have questions, please Ask DON!.
